§6Steam Processing§f

§aUsing steam as a processing medium.§f
Beyond power generation, §bHigh Pressure Steam§f can be used as a processing fluid in various machines. Some recipes require steam as an input rather than just as a power intermediary.

Steam processing is used in certain chemical reactions, material treatments, and advanced fabrication steps. It's a niche but important part of the NuclearCraft ecosystem that you'll encounter as you progress through the mod's recipe chains.

§ePS:§f Check JEI for steam-required recipes. They show up in unexpected places, sometimes in machines you wouldn't associate with steam power. The versatility of steam as both power carrier and processing medium is one of NC's strengths.
